methods.evaluation: Test participants and held-out items only. Fold predictions stitched once per canonical item within seed/condition.
methods.seen_items: Secondary seen-item performance on held-out participants is retained per fold in separate files; never pooled with unseen items or counted as independent folds.
methods.frozen_audit: Separate descriptive audit uses all retained participants and countries, including all 11 Anllo countries. This sample scope differs from held-out adaptation scoring.
methods.order: Map A/B logits to category or 10-point response, then average conditional probabilities across orders equally.
methods.aggregation: Average repetitions within item, items within participant, participants within country; US and China each weight 1/2.
methods.adjustment: One shared semantic log-odds offset fitted only to exact training targets; equal item/order weights; penalty 0.001*delta^2/4.
methods.partial: Partial groups use their available held-out items; contrasts use paired completed folds only. Never compare unmatched partial means.
methods.uncertainty: Descriptive seed and participant values only. No inferential claims, independent-fold assumptions, or confidence intervals.
methods.source_diagnostics: original_valid_mass and original_log_valid_mass refer to the vocabulary distribution before conditional normalization or scalar adjustment.
